title: The Shortest War in History Lasted Under an Hour
description: In 1896, a war between Britain and Zanzibar was over in less than an hour.

scenes.text: The shortest war in recorded history lasted less than an hour.
scenes.subject: ship
scenes.say: [gasps] The shortest war in recorded history lasted less than an HOUR.

scenes.text: It happened in eighteen ninety six, between Britain and Zanzibar, an island off the coast of East Africa.
scenes.subject: zanzibar
scenes.say: It happened in eighteen ninety six, between Britain and Zanzibar, an island off the coast of East Africa.

scenes.text: A new sultan took power without British approval. Britain gave him a deadline to step down, and he refused.
scenes.subject: zanzibar
scenes.say: A new sultan took power without British approval. [serious] Britain gave him a deadline to step down, and he refused.

scenes.text: When the deadline passed, British ships opened fire. The fighting ended in roughly forty minutes.
scenes.subject: ship
scenes.say: When the deadline passed, British ships opened fire. [sighs] The fighting ended in roughly forty minutes.

scenes.text: Shorter than most movies. Follow for more weird facts.
